pages.text: Wireless akaishi energy transmits power across the map directly into distant Input/Output Ports.$(br2)$(bold)Structure:$(reset) a sealed hollow box with edge length 5:$(li)Walls: Wireless Terminal Shell as the base, replaceable by the Terminal, Security Block or Controller$(li)Cavity: exactly 1 Wireless Terminal Core, plus air or modules$(li)The controller is mounted on a wall; only then does the terminal become the network's energy hub.

$(bold)Bound storage:$(reset) the terminal automatically binds Energy Cells within 1 block outside the structure as the network's battery pool; capacity increases by placing more cells around the box.$(br2)$(bold)Authentication:$(reset) identity cards are authorized on the Security page; one terminal supports up to 8 cards, and only authorized cards may join.$(br2)$(bold)Chunk cost:$(reset) with a Chunk Loader module installed, every weakly-loaded chunk costs 1000 energy per tick (billed every 20 ticks). If power is insufficient, chunk loading pauses and resumes automatically once power returns.

$(bold)The identity card authenticates the grid:$(reset)$(li)Authorize the card number at the terminal first (8-card limit)$(li)Place an Input/Output Port at a distance, then right-click it while holding the same card to bind; ports trust the card, not the player$(br2)$(bold)Transfer is uncapped:$(reset) the card provides authentication only; wireless transfer has no rate cap and no tiers, and the card cannot be upgraded.$(br2)Transfer per tick is limited only by the port's buffer and the terminal's bound storage; loss still applies by distance (next page).

$(bold)Transmission loss:$(reset)$(li)Same dimension: base 5% + 0.1% per block of distance, capped at 50%$(li)Cross-dimension: flat 25%, unlocked only when the terminal cavity contains a Dimension Bridge module$(br2)$(bold)Reducing loss:$(reset)$(li)Input/Output Loss Suppression modules reduce loss by 5% each, stacking up to a 90% reduction$(li)Chunk Loader weakly loads the terminal's chunks and every port's chunks; transfers continue while the player is away$(li)Chunk Range module expands each loaded chunk into a 3×3 area$(br2)Modules are placed inside the cavity.

$(bold)Wireless Portable Terminal$(reset): a read-only remote.$(br2)On right-click it scans the inventory for an identity card, looks up the matching network, and displays stored energy, port counts and card IDs.$(br2)It only monitors and does not transmit. For power transfer, use Input/Output Ports.
Reading order: generate power with the Energy Generator and store it in Energy Cells first, then build the wireless grid; for bulk generation, see the Matrix Structures entry.
